description: This file defines an immutable data class 'JLGClientData' used for representing client information with loans, savings, and attendance details within the Apache Fineract project. It provides factory methods to instantiate objects with various configurations and includes getter and setter methods for loans and savings collections.

classes.name: JLGClientData
classes.description: Immutable data object for clients with loans due for disbursement or collection, containing client details, loans, savings, and attendance type.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a JLGClientData instance with clientId, clientName, and attendanceType.

methods.name: withSavings
methods.description: Factory method to create a JLGClientData instance based on an existing client with added savings information.

methods.name: withAttendance
methods.description: Factory method to create a JLGClientData instance with specific attendance type.

methods.name: getLoans
methods.description: Returns the collection of loans due data.

methods.name: setLoans
methods.description: Sets the collection of loans due data.

methods.name: getSavings
methods.description: Returns the collection of savings due data.

methods.name: setSavings
methods.description: Sets the collection of savings due data.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides default equality to compare based on clientId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to use clientId's hash code.
